the tricyciclic ketolides, TE-802 and analogs, possess potent antibacterial activity against erythromycin-sensitive and -resistant S. pneumoniae and S. aureus.

the tricycic ketolides TE802 and TE-802a, with a 9,11- diazaheptane ring in the side chain, are potent and broad spectrum antibacterial agents against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, including erythromycin-sensitive and erythromycin- resistant strains.
